# floodwise

> England flood-risk-by-postcode lookups for AI agents. Returns the Environment Agency's official
> long-term flood-risk band (High/Medium/Low/Very Low) for the AREA around an England postcode, with
> per-band address counts and a separate groundwater indication — from official open data (Open
> Government Licence), not the model's memory. Ships as an MCP server and a typed TypeScript library.
> By Qiniso — verified, trustworthy data tools for AI agents.

## What it does
- flood_risk_by_postcode: EA long-term flood-risk band for an England postcode + per-band address counts + groundwater (Possible/Unlikely). Honest "not found" outside England or for unknown postcodes.
- validate_postcode: deterministic UK postcode format check + outcode/incode split (no lookup).

## Why
Per-postcode flood risk is exact, curated, quarterly-changing reference data a language model cannot recall; asked anyway it invents a plausible risk level with full confidence. floodwise returns the official EA indication by lookup, or an honest "not found".

## Scope and limits (important)
- ENGLAND ONLY — Environment Agency data. Not Wales (Natural Resources Wales), Scotland (SEPA) or Northern Ireland (DfI). Valid non-England postcodes return "not found", never a guess.
- AREA-level, not property-level. The EA states the data is "generally not suitable for property level assessment".
- LONG-TERM risk (annual chance), not a live flood warning.
- Not insurance, underwriting, surveying or professional advice. Excludes highway drains, sewers and overland flow; groundwater is separate from the headline band.

## Data
Environment Agency "Flood risk: postcode search tool data" (England), Open Government Licence v3.0, refreshed ~quarterly. Bands are the highest long-term risk from rivers, sea or surface water for the area around addresses in the postcode. Every response reports datasetVersion and dataset kind (sample vs ea-official). Contains public sector information licensed under the OGL v3.0; © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right.

## Install
- Local MCP: npx -y floodwise  (tools: flood_risk_by_postcode, validate_postcode)
- Library: npm install floodwise
- A hosted edge endpoint is planned (full dataset moves to Cloudflare D1 first).
